title: Nell's Long Trip
note: b383 — single-character book (Nell only). Page 4's 'bent stem' and page 6's 'stem' are both the existing 'twig' prop scaled up and placed upright, rather than a new stem/stalk prop — the same part reused for two different briefs.

pages.brief: Nell setting off from the hive behind the sunflowers, the whole meadow spread out ahead of her. Small bee, big landscape, sense of a journey starting.
pages.alt: Nell sets off from the hive behind the sunflowers, a small bee against the whole meadow spread out ahead of her.

pages.brief: Aerial view: the pond seen from above with Nell's tiny flight path curving past it. Map-like, showing distance covered.
pages.alt: An aerial, map-like view of the pond from above, with Nell's tiny flight path curving past it and the distance covered stretching behind.

pages.brief: Nell battling a strong wind, blown sideways off her course, wings straining, grass flattened in waves below her.
pages.alt: Nell battles a strong wind, blown sideways off her course, wings straining, as the grass flattens in waves below her.

pages.brief: Nell landed on a bent stem, wings drooping, visibly worn out. Everything about her posture says tired.
pages.alt: Nell lands on a bent stem, her wings drooping, every line of her posture saying how tired she is.

pages.brief: Nell drinking from a bead of dew on a leaf and eating a crumb of pollen, restored and content. Close, warm, detailed.
pages.alt: Close on Nell drinking a bead of dew from a leaf, restored and content after her rest.

pages.brief: A line of ants marching briskly up the same stem past Nell, single file, ignoring her entirely. Funny and busy.
pages.alt: A line of ants marches briskly up the stem past Nell in single file, completely ignoring her.

pages.brief: The hive coming into view over the sunflowers, Nell putting on a burst of speed towards it, sheer relief on her face.
pages.alt: The hive comes into view over the sunflowers as Nell puts on a burst of speed towards it, sheer relief on her face.

pages.brief: Closing page: Nell tucked up in the hive entrance at dusk, sunflowers glowing behind, the long journey behind her. Warm gold, deep rest.
pages.alt: Closing page: Nell is tucked up resting in the hive entrance at dusk, the sunflowers glowing behind her and the long trip behind her.
